description: This file defines the class VTEventCondition, which appears to be used for evaluating conditions or expressions in the context of event handling within the vtiger CRM system. classes.name: VTEventCondition
classes.description: A class that represents a condition or expression used for event filtering or validation in vtiger CRM. It provides methods for constructing, testing, and evaluating expressions against data objects.
